item.title: Woodgreen by Martinko Studios
item.description: The Woodgreen House is sited with careful consideration of landscape and solar orientation, preserving six mature fruit trees that anchor the property while maximizing access to natural light. Designed in close collaboration with a family that frequently entertains, the home reflects a client-centered approach that prioritizes openness, fluid circulation, and spatial generosity. item.title: ‘We Measure Success by Performance and Longevity:’ A Conversation With Emerging Voices Winners CO Adaptive
item.description: Featured in our latest Studio Snapshot is Brooklyn-based architecture studio CO Adaptive, founded by Ruth Mandl and Bobby Johnston in 2011. The firm describes itself as an "unbuild, design, and build practice," offering a refreshing and much-needed commitment to reuse, repurpose, and maintain.
